claim_limits: One closed observed bounded matrix. No quiet-host, repeated headroom, causal optimization speedup, broad throughput or scaling acceptance.

Baseline b1a5972d TLC/W8 stopped after its native 900-second budget during temporal-analysis/atoms, with physical and JSON exit 5 and no TLC_SUCCESS. Completion time is censored; no completion speed factor is defined.

The 16-GiB memory request is the native sampled RSS+swap budget, not an allocation-time hard cap. GNU maximum RSS is a separate observation. The service cgroup MemoryMax was 26 GiB. Native collector/Store accounting remains incomplete; the 12,162,744-byte fairness accepted-storage metric excludes allocator overhead and is not total process memory.

TLC policies come from the three pinned historical goldens, generated 2026-10-16/17 using pinned JRE 17.0.20.1+1, TLC SHA 7beec0f04818732a62fa193731711a99aa4f11279499b2360a7d156c519ea78d, W1, seed/fp0, final lncheck, ParallelGC, Xmx3g, Xss8m and 600-second harness timeouts. They are observables/policy provenance, not fresh matched speed benchmarks.

The preserved active CPU/NUMA/cgroup observation covers the first physical cell. The runner asserts its own 0-15 affinity, children inherit that policy, and no per-cell CPU-affinity snapshot was recorded. Collected terminal units return inactive default policy fields; the earlier active snapshot supplies the live limits.

Fresh capacity audit only: no new model, build, test-suite, TLC, network or cloud execution. Required CI, semantic controls and broader qualification are separate gates; this review does not relabel their evidence.
No Bcast deep-target, allocator framework, #651, M1/M2, full-v1, engine-default, RC/release or broad TLC-replacement closure is supplied.
Cloud cleanup was verified from saved root API observations and bindings; this reviewer made no cloud API call.
